title: Super Mario World
engine: the snesrev/smw C reimplementation (SDL2, built with Emscripten)
description: The 16-bit side-scroller across Dinosaur Land, rebuilt from its C reimplementation.
overview: Super Mario World running in the browser from the snesrev/smw C reimplementation, compiled to WebAssembly. Every retail picture, colour table and instrument sample has been regenerated by the clean-room pipeline from coarse facts, so the build ships no original ROM, graphics or audio.
engineLicense: MIT (snesrev/smw); see the upstream project and the clean-room repository
assetLicense: Regenerated clean-room assets; no retail data is distributed
controls: Gamepad — any standard controller, detected automatically
Touch — on-screen SNES pad on phones and tablets when no controller is connected
saveInstructions: Progress is stored by the build in this browser, under andrewnakas.github.io. Clearing site data removes it.
limitations: Regenerated graphics and audio differ from the retail game by design.

verification.scope: Headless test booted the build, started a file, crossed the overworld and entered Yoshi's Island 1 with audio running. Taint scan reported 0 failing.
